name: 92866 · Orange, CA
findings: ZIP 92866 (Orange) has 101 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92866 (Orange) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
41% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92866 (Orange) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.4 times the typical level).
